title: Should We Text the Aliens First?
summary: A risk analyst, an allotment radio ham, a contrarian linguist and a cruise-ship crooner argue over whether humanity should transmit a hello to the stars or keep listening.

delivery.Juno Partridge: with dry, quick, mock-solemn authority, enjoying the fight
delivery.Dr. Odalys Venn: with bone-dry, precise calm, faintly weary
delivery.Barnaby \"Beacon\" Okafor-Lund: excitedly, talking fast, warm and misty-eyed
delivery.Gus Fennimore: like a seasoned showman, gravelly and cheerful, with a wink
